content: 1 A thanksgiving psalm. Shout out praises to the LORD, all the earth! 2 Worship the LORD with joy! Enter his presence with joyful singing! 3 Acknowledge that the LORD is God! He made us and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep of his pasture. 4 Enter his gates with thanksgiving, and his courts with praise! Give him thanks! Praise his name! 5 For the LORD is good. His loyal love endures, and he is faithful through all generations.
